stories.title: Bills star DT Oliver mourning tragic death of son
stories.summary: The 2-year-old son of Bills defensive tackle Ed Oliver died June 28 after he was found unresponsive in a swimming pool by family members at a residence outside Houston.

stories.title: Stewart wants safe space amid transgender rallies
stories.summary: Liberty star Breanna Stewart says she hopes WNBA arenas can be a "safe space" for fans amid rallies about transgender sports participation.

stories.title: Texas dismisses LB Smith for detrimental conduct
stories.summary: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian said linebacker Ty'Anthony Smith was dismissed from the program for conduct detrimental to the team.

stories.title: Sources: Alabama names Russell QB1 for opener
stories.summary: Alabama has named Keelon Russell as the starting quarterback for its Sept. 5 season opener against East Carolina, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

stories.title: De Zerbi: Spurs not ready, lacking fight in loss
stories.summary: Roberto De Zerbi has said that Tottenham are undercooked and "lacking fight" after they slumped to a 3-0 defeat at Brentford.
